test_has_return_dict_branching: test the _has_return_dict_branching function to detect old return_dict branching patterns in AST function nodes
check_trf003_violations: check a Python AST tree for TRF003 violations where forward() uses manual return_dict branching instead of decorators
refactor_forward_return_dict: refactor a model's forward method to replace manual return_dict branching with @can_return_tuple or @capture_output decorators
review_pretrained_class_forward: review pretrained model classes to ensure their forward methods use decorator-based return handling instead of if/else branches
summarize_trf003_rule: summarize the TRF003 lint rule that enforces decorator usage over manual return_dict branching in transformer model forward methods
